spanish: Y persiguió Egipto detrás de ellos, y los alcanzaron acampados sobre el mar, todo caballo del carro de Faraón y sus jinetes y su ejército, sobre Pi Hajirot, delante de Baal Tsefon.
grammarChanges: Changed 'persiguieron' to 'persiguió' to agree with the singular subject Egipto; the plural verb let Egipto be read as the one pursued instead of the pursuer.
Removed the comma between 'caballo' and 'carro' and inserted 'del' to keep caballo-carro-Faraón as one construct chain (todo caballo del carro de Faraón) instead of a list.
readerNote: Chose singular persiguió over plural persiguieron so Egipto reads clearly as the one pursuing, and joined caballo to carro with del to keep the single construct chain instead of a list.
